topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I just can’t avoid the way my hands tremble slightly as I read the note from Sarah, our neighbor. She’s asking to use a piece of our yard for a garden. It’s not like we’re using that corner much, but the idea of giving up control, even just a little, feels unbearable. The edges of the paper crinkle under my grip. I know I should be happy for her, for wanting to grow something beautiful, but all I can think about is how it’ll change things, how it might not stay just a garden. I need to think, to find a way to say no without sounding cruel, but the words won’t form. Not yet.
